inputs.pool: runs/adsb_nn/nnb_s101 .. nnb_s132/seasonal/stop_predictions.parquet (32 seeds = ens_nn + ens_new, equal weights)

protocol.data: tools/run_adsb_rnn.py --held-out 2025-10 --design: fit on the in-scope rows of the eleven other 2025 months (the residual stage's leave-one-month-out fold for October, the fold adsb_v25's October columns come from), monitor October every epoch (record only; fixed 16 epochs, final-epoch weights); write October's predictions only.
protocol.decision: The adsb_rnn twelve-month leave-one-month-out goes ahead only if, for at least one variant, the 4-seed mean's recipe reading (all October rows) at its best w in 0.1..0.9 is at least 0.02% below the control (the selection bar of every round since adsb_v25). The declaration then fixes the variant(s), seeds and the candidate weights from these October readings alone. Otherwise the round stops with a recorded null.
protocol.never_read: No design run predicts or scores a recipe month (2025-01/07/11/12) or a ranking month; those months enter only as fitting rows, as in every leave-one-month-out fold.
protocol.readings: tools/rnn_design_report.py on October 2025: scope RMSE of v9 + r for the network, the equal thirds mean(adj2, cat, net) and (1 - w) x mean(adj2, cat) + w x net, w = 0.1..0.9; v25's non-LIRF recipe rebuilt on October (0.3 x (v9 + r) + 0.7 x (0.5 committee + 0.5 32-seed pool), floored; committee and pool from their October-out-of-sample seasonal-fold models; LIRF rows at v9 for every candidate), ratio to the control on all rows (primary) and non-LIRF rows; seed means of the first k seeds per variant; the equal-compute mix rnb 1-2 + rwide 1-2.

purpose: Design reading for a neural-network member of the residual stage (label - cross-fit v9 on matched rows outside LIRF), the one component of the v25 recipe that has never had a network. v25's residual is the mean of a month-weighted LightGBM (adj2) and a CatBoost (cat); residual-model tuning is exhausted (adsb_v26/v27), so a new model family is the remaining lever there. Two input sets: nb (the residual trees' 33 columns: family diversity at equal information) and wide (nb + the committee learners' timeline and v19 features: more information, but closer to the committee networks already in the recipe). Caution recorded before any fit: residual-scope gains reach the recipe damped about 20:1 (adsb_v25 -1.96% scope -> -0.057% recipe; adsb_v27 -0.218% -> -0.0135%).
